basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 5+ years shipping full-stack features, API integrations, and Kafka data pipelines for enterprise platforms. Translates business needs into technical solutions and works across technical and non-technical teams.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on enterprise financial platforms, working across international teams.
highlights: Developed full-stack features with TypeScript, React, and Redux on the frontend and Spring Boot with Java 21 on the backend, integrating with internal systems.
Optimized Oracle SQL schemas, stored procedures, JPA/Hibernate mappings, and high-throughput Apache Kafka pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions.
Consolidated disparate historical storage into Snowflake on Azure, managing storage costs while ensuring high availability for cross-functional teams.
Staffed on-call rotations for business-critical financial platforms, triaging team-wide incidents and outages and escalating to the appropriate owners.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Frontend-focused engineer on security tooling for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Created a React/Redux security dashboard for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
Resolved critical logic flaws in security risk-scoring algorithms, improving data accuracy and reducing false-positive alerts for enterprise clients.
Implemented Jest and Cypress suites that improved feature reliability and UI performance, and wrote real-time browser tests ensuring end-to-end application stability.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Full-stack automation engineer building business process solutions with C#/.NET and SQL.
highlights: Orchestrated full-stack automation in C#/.NET and SQL across OCR, HR, and fundraising departments to improve workflows.

projects.name: dossier
projects.description: Local-first CLI that runs OpenCode agent prompts to produce grounded resumes, proposals, and application answers from a career fact bank.
highlights: Engineered an OpenCode-agent pipeline that tailors resumes, proposals, and application answers from a local fact bank
Recorded an evidence trace for every generated claim and verified outputs before rendering

projects.name: Meal Planner
projects.description: Full-stack household meal-planning application that turns shared weekly decisions into an actionable grocery workflow.
highlights: Delivered a multi-user SvelteKit and Convex app with household onboarding and real-time shared planning, plus a multi-step Google OAuth2 flow handling redirects and session state

projects.name: SlippiOS
projects.description: Bootable USB image that runs a Melee console with a Godot shell, a Go backend, and Secure Boot support.
highlights: Published 0.5.0 of a bootable USB image with A/B system updates, Wi-Fi setup, and signed Secure Boot images
Integrated a Go backend with Cobra CLI commands and GraphQL routes, covering browser sign-in, network ISO upload, and native GameCube-adapter input
